champion_v2.what: CHAMPION V2 — the board's pick product: the champion's own live totals engine (unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (+EV/vig gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers by the champion's own edge size, nightly grading). PREGAME TOTALS ONLY.
champion_v2.star_basis: STAR SYSTEM v3 (Leon, 2026-07-07): RATE EVERY GAME — every row carries 1-5 stars, an always-populated lean={side,line}, a continuous 0-5 score, and playable=(stars>=2). 1 star = WE WOULD PASS (the lean is still stated, clearly labeled Pass): rows that fail the +EV gate at the real latest per-side price, and the toxic tail |edge| >= 0.065 — measured ANTI-signal on the champion's own graded 2022-2026 history (33-43, hit 43.4%, ROI -17.1%; 947 graded picks, 892 decided, day-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs — v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md). Playable tiers are the MEASURED divergence bands: 4 stars = Tier A 0.04 <= |edge| < 0.065, the sweet spot (248-153, hit 61.8% [57.1-66.5], ROI +17.6% [+8.6..+26.5], ROI-positive every season 2022-2026); 3 stars = 0.03-0.04 (234-177, hit 56.9% [52.4-61.6], ROI +8.7% [-0.0..+17.8]); 2 stars = the smallest playable edges, |edge| < 0.03 past the +EV gate (Tier B lives here — only 4 graded decided picks ever, thin history, lowest playable conviction). The +EV gate is the PLAYABLE boundary: a -EV row can NEVER be 2 stars or better. CEILING 4 stars — the champion is NOT BH-certified on the v4 sealed walk (dev-null on re-derivation), so 5 stars stays reserved for BH-certified cells. CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08: stop pure price-chasing flip-flops): PLAYABLE additionally requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE — |our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01. A row that clears +EV purely on plus-money juice while the model essentially agrees with the fair number is a 1-star 'price-only edge — no model conviction' lean, never playable. PLAYABLE = +EV at the real per-side price AND model divergence >= 0.01. SCORE/STAR v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09: TRUE continuous percentile — fixes the v3.1 structural flaw where the score was quantized by absolute edge band first, so a 2-star-band pick scoring 2.00-2.99 could NEVER cross the frozen 3-star cutoff ~3.06 and the middle tier starved): score v3.2 = 2.0 + 3.0 * strength_percentile for PLAYABLE rows (2.00-4.99, continuous — no band quantization); strength = 0.5*pct_rank(|our_prob − market_devig_prob|) + 0.5*pct_rank(ev), ranks against the FROZEN season playable distribution (score_reference); strength_percentile = pct_rank of that blend against the frozen blend distribution. Non-playable (1*) rows: score = 1.99 * their percentile within the frozen NON-playable distribution (tail-inverted edge measure — deeper into the measured >=0.065 anti-signal scores lower; no price -> 0) — passes rank against each other, always < 2.0. BH-certified 5* rows score 5.0. Stars = floor bands of the score: 2.00-2.99 -> 2*, 3.00-3.99 -> 3*, 4.00-4.99 -> 4* (~ a third of the playable percentile each). The frozen season reference lives in v4/models/output/score_reference_v32.json (payload `score_reference`), recomputed only on the nightly replay regen, never per-day. The measured absolute-edge-band records quoted above are historical calibration context, not the star bands' definition — under v3.2 the tiers are relative conviction (thirds of the season playable strength percentile) and the by_star_tier records in the record block are the live measurement of what each band earns. The 1-star PASS set, the +EV playable boundary, the 4-star ceiling (playable scores clamp below 5.0 — 5 stays BH-reserved) and featured (= highest score) are all unchanged; a non-playable row is never promoted and always scores < 2.0.
model_notes: SCORE/STAR v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09): the continuous score is now a TRUE season percentile — 2.0 + 3.0 x the pick's strength percentile (0.5 x |divergence| rank + 0.5 x EV rank) within the frozen playable reference — and stars are plain floor bands of it (2.00-2.99/3.00-3.99/4.00-4.99 -> 2/3/4 stars, ~a third of the playable percentile each). Fixes the v3.1 structural flaw: the old score was quantized by absolute edge band BEFORE the percentile cutoffs, so a 2-star-band pick (score 2.00-2.99) could never cross the frozen 3-star cutoff (~3.06) — 3 stars was structurally starved. LOCKED rows keep their frozen pre-fix stamps (the lock rule is absolute); v3.2 applies to rows written/re-rendered from 2026-07-09 on. Non-playable rows rank among themselves at 0.00-1.99; the -EV floor, conviction floor, toxic-tail demotion and the 4-star ceiling are unchanged.

HARD LOCK + CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08): (1) picks HARD-LOCK at first pitch — once a game starts, its board rows are IMMUTABLE (the judged Vegas line/side/price/stars freeze at the last pre-start state; grading uses exactly that locked state; `locked_at` carries the freeze wall + timestamp). Each WALL row is also first-write-wins: once written it is never overwritten by a later cycle. (2) playable now requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE (|our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01) on top of +EV — micro-edges that only exist because of plus-money juice are 1-star 'price-only' leans. Both fixes answer the observed all-unders -> all-overs board flip between cycles: unstable price-driven micro-edges are no longer playable, and nothing re-writes after the freeze.

DEV-NULL (2026-07-07, v4/models/UNIFIED_TOTALS.md): the champion's edge does NOT reproduce when re-derived on the Odds-API 5-DP odds table — the champion-style path graded flat (+0.1% on 283 dev picks, 2022-25) and the V4 GBM residual path was actively anti-signal at high divergence (-16.6%). CHAMPION V2 therefore uses the champion's OWN pipeline (its snapshot stack + frozen model + frozen policy) as the pick source; V4 adds serving-time discipline (+EV gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers, nightly grading) — it does NOT re-derive the signal.

HABITAT EROSION WARNING: the champion's trigger habitat — cross-book totals dispersion — is structurally shrinking: T-3h line_std 0.126 (2023) -> 0.096 (2024) -> 0.083 (2025) -> 0.076 (2026); share of slates with >=2 distinct lines 67% -> 48% -> 43% -> 39%; books quoted 16.7 -> 11.7 -> 10.9 -> 11.0. Expect fewer qualifying picks over time. The record display is the ongoing proof either way — no edge is presumed.

STAR RECALIBRATION (2026-07-07, v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md): star tiers were re-fit to the champion's own measured 2022-2026 bucket win-rates (day-clustered CIs). The edge-ROI gradient is NOT monotone — it is an inverted U: 0.03-0.04 hit 56.9% ROI +8.7%; 0.04-0.065 hit 61.8% ROI +17.6%; >= 0.065 hit 43.4% ROI -17.1% (extreme divergence is where the champion is most WRONG, not most right; sweet-spot-vs-tail ROI gap +34.8pp, 95% CI +11.4..+58.1). Stars therefore peak at 0.04-0.065 and the >= 0.065 tail is demoted out of the playable tiers.

STAR SYSTEM v3.1 (2026-07-07, Leon: 'normalize all picks — I want to make sure we get some 4s'): playable stars re-tiered from absolute edge bands to NORMALIZED PERCENTILE BANDS of the unchanged continuous score (4* = top ~10% of playable scores season-wide, 3* = next ~25%, 2* = rest; cutoffs frozen from the season replay distribution, refreshed only on the nightly regen). Honest consequence: a star tier is now a RELATIVE conviction band, not a measured edge bucket — read the by_star_tier records for what each band actually earns. The -EV floor is hard (normalization never promotes a non-playable row); 1* passes, the toxic-tail demotion, the 4* ceiling and featured are unchanged.

STAR SYSTEM v3 (2026-07-07, same day, Leon): rate EVERY game — no empty cells. 1 star now MEANS 'we would pass' (the lean side+line is still shown); the toxic >= 0.065 tail is a 1-star PASS, no longer a bet, so the headline record is over the PLAYABLE (2-4 star) set. Tier B moved from a 1-star lean to 2 stars: it clears the +EV gate below 0.03 divergence — playable at the lowest conviction, on thin history (4 graded decided picks ever), not on proven skill. Every row carries a continuous 0-5 `score` (stars + within-band edge/EV blend) and the payloads expose per-day featured_game_id = the highest score of the day (playable first; all-pass days feature the best lean, flagged).

star_basis.note: SCORE/STAR v3.2: every row is rated 1-5 (1* = rated PASS with its lean stated; no empty cells) and carries a continuous 0-5 `score` + `playable` + `lean`. The score is a TRUE season percentile: 2.0 + 3.0 x the row's strength percentile (0.5 x |divergence| rank + 0.5 x EV rank) within the FROZEN playable reference (`score_reference`, recomputed only on the nightly replay regen — never per-day, so a dead slate cannot fake a 4*). Stars are plain FLOOR BANDS of the score (2.00-2.99/3.00-3.99/4.00-4.99 -> 2/3/4* — ~a third of the playable percentile each; the v3.1 gap that structurally starved 3* is fixed). Non-playable rows rank among themselves at 0.00-1.99. The +EV gate is the playable boundary (-EV is never 2*+); the toxic >=0.065 tail and junk (one-sided) cells demote to 1*; 5* stays reserved for BH-certified cells (none yet). Tiers are relative conviction — read the by_star_tier records for what each band measures.
